headlines.title: 中国证监会拟对17起案件线索的“吹哨人”给予奖励
headlines.summary: 近日，中国证监会拟根据《证券法》等相关法律法规，对提供以下案件线索的“吹哨人”依法给予奖励： （一）沈阳远大智能工业集团股份有限公司信息披露违法违规案（辽宁证监局行政处罚决定书〔2025〕8号） （二）新疆冠农股份有限公司信息披露违法违规案（新疆证监局行政处罚决定书〔2023〕4号） （三）海南大东海旅游中心股份有限公司信息披露违法案（海南证监局行政处罚决定书〔2023〕1号） （四）吉林利源精制股份有限公司信息披露违法违规案（吉林证监局行政处罚决定书〔2022〕2号）

headlines.title_en: CSRC plans to reward whistleblowers in 17 case leads
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the CSRC intends to grant rewards, in accordance with the Securities Law and other relevant laws and regulations, to "whistleblowers" who provide clues in the following cases: (1) Shenyang Yuanda Intelligent Industry Group Co., Ltd. information disclosure violation case (Liaoning Securities Regulatory Bureau Administrative Penalty Decision [2025] No. 8); (2) Xinjiang Guannong Co., Ltd. information disclosure violation case (Xinjiang Securities Regulatory Bureau Administrative Penalty Decision [2023] No. 4); (3) Hainan Dadonghai Tourism Centre Co., Ltd. information disclosure violation case (Hainan Securities Regulatory Bureau Administrative Penalty Decision [2023] No. 1); (4) Jilin Liyuan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. information disclosure violation case (Jilin Securities Regulatory Bureau Administrative Penalty Decision [2022] No. 2).

headlines.title: 国常会：听取老龄工作情况汇报
headlines.summary: 会议指出，要全面客观认识人口老龄化带来的影响，深入实施积极应对人口老龄化国家战略，推动老龄事业全面发展进步。要着力提升老年人服务保障水平，在养老服务、健康促进、社会保障等方面持续用力，健全多层次多支柱养老保险体系，打通居家、社区、机构养老服务联动渠道，扩大普惠养老服务。要针对老年群体特征，丰富银发产品和服务，培育银发消费新场景，更好满足老年人消费需求，实现民生福祉与内需扩容双向促进。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: briefed on work related to aging
headlines.summary_en: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to comprehensively and objectively understand the impact of population aging, deeply implement the national strategy of actively responding to population aging, and promote the all-round development and progress of undertakings for the elderly. Efforts should be made to improve the level of services and safeguards for the elderly, continue to make sustained efforts in elderly care services, health promotion, and social security, improve the multi-tiered and multi-pillar old-age insurance system, open up channels for coordinated home, community, and institutional elderly care services, and expand inclusive elderly care services. In response to the characteristics of the elderly group, it is necessary to enrich silver economy products and services, cultivate new silver consumption scenarios, better meet the consumption needs of the elderly, and achieve two-way promotion of people's livelihood and welfare and expansion of domestic demand. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: SSE: shares of newly listed Shengu Group fluctuated sharply; self-regulatory measures including suspension of account trading taken against relevant investors in accordance with rules
headlines.summary_en: According to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, from September 14, 2026 to September 18, 2026, the SSE took self-regulatory measures against 50 cases of abnormal securities trading behavior such as ramping up and suppressing prices and false declarations, focused monitoring on stocks with relatively large fluctuations such as Longban Media, conducted special verification of 33 major matters of listed companies, and reported 2 suspected illegal and irregular case clues to the CSRC.

headlines.title: 国常会：部署实施医疗康复护理扩容提升工程
headlines.summary: 会议指出，要以基层为重点建强医疗康复护理服务体系，推动康复护理资源向社区、家庭延伸，增强城乡居民康复护理服务可及性。要依靠科技创新提升医疗康复护理水平，开发更多智能康复技术和设备，优化新技术新产品审评审批，丰富服务场景。要强化医疗康复护理支持保障，动态调整康复医疗、长期照护服务项目目录，深化医疗康复护理服务价格改革，完善人才培养政策，不断增强职业吸引力。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: deployed implementation of the medical rehabilitation and nursing capacity expansion and upgrading project
headlines.summary_en: The meeting pointed out that it is necessary to focus on the grassroots level to build a strong medical rehabilitation and nursing service system, promote the extension of rehabilitation and nursing resources to communities and families, and enhance the accessibility of rehabilitation and nursing services for urban and rural residents. It is necessary to rely on scientific and technological innovation to improve the level of medical rehabilitation and nursing, develop more intelligent rehabilitation technologies and equipment, optimize the review and approval of new technologies and new products, and enrich service scenarios. It is necessary to strengthen support and safeguards for medical rehabilitation and nursing, dynamically adjust the catalog of rehabilitation medical and long-term care service items, deepen the price reform of medical rehabilitation and nursing services, improve talent training policies, and continuously enhance the attractiveness of the profession. (CCTV News)

headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 18 - Aihua Group announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to no more than 35 (including this number) specific investors, with total funds raised not exceeding RMB 1.88 billion (including this number), of which RMB 1.5 billion will be used for Aihua Group's integrated high-end capacitor production capacity expansion project, and RMB 380 million will be used to supplement working capital. headlines.title: “波澜不惊”成外汇市场新常态 但低波动也埋下定时炸弹
headlines.summary: 汇率波动率长期处于如此低的水平，以至于交易员开始将其视为一种新常态，而非暂时现象。本周在阿姆斯特丹举行的年度行业会议上，低波动环境连续第二年成为主要议题之一。投资者形容，当前市场即使债券、油价和地缘政治局势出现剧烈变化，也依然难以引发汇率持续大幅波动。“我们感叹的是汇率波动率正在经历长期的趋势性下降，”系统性趋势跟踪基金AlphaEngine Global Investment Solutions联席首席投资官Harish Neelakandan表示。“这就是我们面对的现实，我们必须学会适应。”
headlines.title_zh: “波澜不惊”成外汇市场新常态 但低波动也埋下定时炸弹
headlines.summary_zh: 汇率波动率长期处于如此低的水平，以至于交易员开始将其视为一种新常态，而非暂时现象。本周在阿姆斯特丹举行的年度行业会议上，低波动环境连续第二年成为主要议题之一。投资者形容，当前市场即使债券、油价和地缘政治局势出现剧烈变化，也依然难以引发汇率持续大幅波动。“我们感叹的是汇率波动率正在经历长期的趋势性下降，”系统性趋势跟踪基金AlphaEngine Global Investment Solutions联席首席投资官Harish Neelakandan表示。“这就是我们面对的现实，我们必须学会适应。”
headlines.title_en: 'Calm waters' become the new normal for the forex market, but low volatility also plants a time bomb
headlines.summary_en: Exchange rate volatility has been at such a low level for so long that traders have begun to regard it as a new normal rather than a temporary phenomenon. At this week's annual industry conference in Amsterdam, the low-volatility environment became one of the main topics for the second consecutive year. Investors described the current market as one in which even sharp changes in bonds, oil prices, and geopolitics still find it difficult to trigger sustained large exchange rate fluctuations. "What we lament is that exchange rate volatility is undergoing a long-term structural decline," said Harish Neelakandan, co-chief investment officer of systematic trend-following fund AlphaEngine Global Investment Solutions. "This is the reality we face, and we must learn to adapt."

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: securities transaction stamp duty reached 216 billion yuan in January-August, up 82% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Finance data show that from January to August, national general public budget revenue was 15.6633 trillion yuan, up 5.7% year on year. Among this, stamp tax on securities transactions was 216 billion yuan, up 82% year on year. From January to August, national general public budget expenditure was 18.1451 trillion yuan, up 1.2% year on year.

headlines.title: 央行副行长陆磊：愿与东盟国家加强合作 共同研判人工智能技术衍生的新型金融风险
headlines.summary: 【央行副行长陆磊：愿与东盟国家加强合作 共同研判人工智能技术衍生的新型金融风险】中国人民银行副行长陆磊18日在中国-东盟金融合作与发展论坛上围绕“深化中国与东盟金融领域人工智能合作”这一主题进行了讲话。陆磊表示，在中国实践中，我们始终坚持统筹发展与安全，引导金融机构稳妥有序推进人工智能应用，既充分激活其在海量数据处理、复杂模式识别、多模态内容生成方面的潜能，也充分发挥人在价值判断、伦理决策、创新创造等方面的核心优势，努力实现人工智能金融应用安全、可靠、可控。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: Willing to strengthen cooperation with ASEAN countries to jointly assess new financial risks arising from AI technology
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Deputy Governor Lu Lei: Willing to strengthen cooperation with ASEAN countries to jointly assess new financial risks arising from AI technology] Lu Lei, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, spoke on 18th at the China-ASEAN Financial Cooperation and Development Forum on the theme of "deepening China-ASEAN cooperation in artificial intelligence in the financial sector." Lu Lei said that in China's practice, we have always adhered to coordinating development and security, guiding financial institutions to advance AI applications steadily and in an orderly manner, both fully activating its potential in massive data processing, complex pattern recognition, and multimodal content generation, and fully leveraging human core strengths in value judgment, ethical decision-making, and innovation and creativity, striving to achieve secure, reliable, and controllable AI financial applications.

headlines.title: 国常会：审议通过《中医药传统知识保护条例（草案）》讨论《〈中华人民共和国突发事件应对法〉等15部法律的修正案（草案）》
headlines.summary: 会议指出，中医药理论、技术和方药是我国自主创新的重要资源，要全面加强中医药传统知识保护管理，守护好中医药生存发展根基。要统筹做好中医药资源保护和利用，持续深化对中医药基础理论、诊疗规律、作用机理的研究阐释，加大中医药传统知识推广应用力度，加强对外交流合作，在互学互鉴中提升我国传统医药国际影响力。

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: reviewed and approved the Regulations on the Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine Knowledge (Draft); discussed the draft amendments to 15 laws including the Emergency Response Law of the People's Republic of China
headlines.summary_en: The meeting pointed out that traditional Chinese medicine theory, techniques, and prescriptions are important resources for China's independent innovation. It is necessary to comprehensively strengthen the protection and management of traditional Chinese medicine traditional knowledge and safeguard the foundation for the survival and development of traditional Chinese medicine. It is necessary to coordinate the protection and utilization of traditional Chinese medicine resources, continue to deepen research and interpretation of the basic theories, diagnostic and treatment patterns, and mechanisms of action of traditional Chinese medicine, increase the promotion and application of traditional Chinese medicine traditional knowledge, strengthen foreign exchange and cooperation, and enhance the international influence of China's traditional medicine through mutual learning.

headlines.title: 国常会：研究推动体育赛事健康发展有关工作
headlines.summary: 会议指出，体育赛事对于满足群众多元化生活需求、提高人民生活品质具有重要意义。要增加高质量体育赛事供给，盘活用好各类体育场地设施和赛事资源，统筹发展竞技体育赛事、职业赛事和群众赛事。要推动体育赛事与文化、旅游、商务等融合发展，加快新技术运用，提升观赛体验，放大综合效应。要提高赛事管理保障能力，培育一批专业化赛事运营主体，健全场地、人员和机构管理制度，促进各类赛事安全发展。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: State Council executive meeting: studied work on promoting the healthy development of sports events
headlines.summary_en: The meeting pointed out that sports events are of great significance for meeting the diverse life needs of the people and improving their quality of life. It is necessary to increase the supply of high-quality sports events, revitalize and make good use of various sports venues, facilities, and event resources, and coordinate the development of competitive sports events, professional events, and mass events. It is necessary to promote the integrated development of sports events with culture, tourism, commerce, and other sectors, accelerate the use of new technologies, improve the spectator experience, and amplify the comprehensive effects. It is necessary to improve event management and support capabilities, cultivate a group of specialized event operating entities, improve management systems for venues, personnel, and institutions, and promote the safe development of various events. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 财政部：1—8月国有土地使用权出让收入13753亿元 同比下降28.6%
headlines.summary: 财政部发布数据，1—8月，全国政府性基金预算收入21419亿元，同比下降19%。分中央和地方看，中央政府性基金预算收入3292亿元，同比增长12.2%；地方政府性基金预算本级收入18127亿元，同比下降22.9%，其中，国有土地使用权出让收入13753亿元，同比下降28.6%。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance: state-owned land use right transfer revenue reached 1,375.3 billion yuan in January-August, down 28.6% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance released data showing that from January to August, national government fund budget revenue was 2.1419 trillion yuan, down 19% year on year. By central and local levels, central government fund budget revenue was 329.2 billion yuan, up 12.2% year on year; local government fund budget revenue at the same level was 1.8127 trillion yuan, down 22.9% year on year, among which state-owned land use right transfer revenue was 1.3753 trillion yuan, down 28.6% year on year.

headlines.title: 商务部：下一步积极扩大优质产品进口，促进进出口平衡发展
headlines.summary: 9月18日，国新办举行介绍第140届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）有关情况的新闻发布会。商务部对外贸易司司长杨涛谈了我国外贸表现以及未来预期。杨涛表示，今年前8个月，我国外贸延续了良好的发展态势，进出口规模达到34.8万亿元，增长17.6%，其中，出口增长14.6%，进口增长22%，进口增速明显快于出口。外贸动能向新、结构向优的特征更加明显。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: next step is to actively expand imports of high-quality products and promote balanced development of imports and exports
headlines.summary_en: On September 18, the State Council Information Office held a press conference introducing matters related to the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair). Yang Tao, Director of the Department of Foreign Trade of the Ministry of Commerce, discussed China's foreign trade performance and future expectations. Yang Tao said that in the first eight months of this year, China's foreign trade continued its good development momentum, with the scale of imports and exports reaching 34.8 trillion yuan, an increase of 17.6%, among which exports grew by 14.6% and imports grew by 22%, with import growth clearly faster than export growth. The characteristics of foreign trade momentum turning toward new areas and the structure turning toward improvement are more evident.

headlines.title: 天孚通信：拟使用不超80亿元自有资金进行现金管理
headlines.summary: 天孚通信9月18日公告，公司董事会审议同意公司及子公司在不影响正常经营的前提下，使用不超过人民币80亿元的自有资金进行现金管理，用于购买安全性高、流动性好的理财产品。该事项自公司股东会作出决议之日起十二个月之内有效。在上述额度及决议有效期内，资金可循环滚动使用。本议案尚需提交公司2026年第三次临时股东会审议。

headlines.title_en: T&S Communications: Plans to use no more than RMB 8 billion of its own funds for cash management
headlines.summary_en: Tianfu Communication announced on September 18 that the company's board of directors reviewed and approved the company and its subsidiaries to use no more than RMB 8 billion of their own funds for cash management, without affecting normal operations, to purchase wealth management products with high safety and good liquidity. This matter shall be effective within twelve months from the date the company's shareholders' meeting makes a resolution. Within the above limit and the validity period of the resolution, the funds may be used on a revolving basis. This proposal still needs to be submitted to the company's third extraordinary shareholders' meeting in 2026 for review.

headlines.title: 上交所修订《董秘一本通》， 明确董秘任职资格、兼任限制及过渡期安排等
headlines.summary: 记者获悉，上交所近期向全体沪市上市公司发布《上海证券交易所上市公司董事会秘书履职规则理解一本通（2026年修订）》，此次修订工作进一步整理了新规实施以来上市公司咨询较多的问题，包括董秘职责范围、任职资格、兼任限制、过渡期安排等，旨在帮助上市公司准确把握董秘新规要点，进一步促进和保障董事会秘书履职。根据新规，董秘任职与兼职调整过渡期安排至2027年12月31日，目前已有不少上市公司完成任职调整。上交所表示，将继续做好董秘新规落地实施工作，引导上市公司有序进行过渡期高管任职调整，持续推动上市公司完善治理。（界面）

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange revises the "Board Secretary Handbook", clarifying board secretary qualifications, concurrent post limits, and transitional arrangements
headlines.summary_en: The reporter learned that the SSE recently issued to all listed companies on the Shanghai market the "SSE Listed Company Board Secretary Performance of Duties Rules Comprehension Guide (2026 Revision)." This revision further compiled the issues most frequently consulted by listed companies since the implementation of the new rules, including the scope of the board secretary's duties, qualifications, concurrent appointment restrictions, and transitional arrangements, aiming to help listed companies accurately grasp the key points of the new board secretary rules and further promote and safeguard the performance of duties by board secretaries. According to the new rules, the transitional arrangement for adjustments to board secretary appointments and concurrent positions has been set until December 31, 2027, and many listed companies have already completed appointment adjustments. The SSE stated that it will continue to do a good job in implementing the new board secretary rules, guide listed companies to carry out orderly adjustments to senior management appointments during the transition period, and continue to promote the improvement of corporate governance among listed companies. (Jiemian)

headlines.title: 商务部：预计全年进口额有望再创新高
headlines.summary: 商务部部长助理张力18日在国新办新闻发布会上介绍，今年前8个月，我国进口增长22%，为2021年以来最快，预计全年进口额有望再创新高。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: full-year imports expected to hit a new record high
headlines.summary_en: Assistant Minister of Commerce Zhang Li said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 18th that in the first eight months of this year, China's imports grew by 22%, the fastest since 2021, and the full-year import value is expected to hit a new high. (Shanghai Securities News)
